name: Cursor CLI
tagline: Cursor's terminal agent, sharing models, rules, MCP servers, and cloud agents with the editor.
description: Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) runs Cursor's coding agent from the terminal in interactive, plan, ask, or print mode. It can hand tasks to Cloud Agents and run in managed git worktrees.

pricing.notes: Free plan includes limited agent requests; paid Cursor plans add usage.
